source_of_truth: The canonical IAB source file is authoritative. Line citations refer to the helper source file used for structured extraction.

fields.name: bseat
fields.type_spec: string array from bidding on this impression. IDs of seats and knowledge of the buyer’s customers to which they refer must be coordinated between bidders and the exchange a priori. At most, only one of wseat and bseat should be used in the same request. Omission of both implies no seat restrictions.

fields.name: cur
fields.type_spec: string array ISO-4217 alpha codes. Recommended only if the exchange accepts multiple currencies.

fields.name: wlang
fields.type_spec: string array Omission implies no specific restrictions, but buyers would be advised to consider language attribute in the Device and/or Content objects if available.

fields.name: bcat
fields.type_spec: string array categories. Refer to List 5.1.

fields.name: bapp
fields.type_spec: string array independent application identifiers. On Android, these should be bundle or package names (e.g., com.foo.mygame). On iOS, these are numeric IDs.

fields.name: source
fields.type_spec: object inventory source and which entity makes the final decision.

fields.name: regs
fields.type_spec: object or governmental regulations in force for this request.

fields.name: adomain
fields.type_spec: string array This can be an array of for the case of rotating creatives. Exchanges can mandate that only one domain is allowed.

fields.name: bundle
fields.type_spec: string unique to the app and independent of the exchange. On Android, this should be a bundle or package name (e.g., com.foo.mygame). On iOS, it is a numeric ID.

fields.name: iurl
fields.type_spec: string of the content of the campaign for ad quality/safety checking.

fields.name: cid
fields.type_spec: string of creatives for which iurl should be representative.

fields.name: tactic
fields.type_spec: string exchange the tactic through which their bid was submitted. The specific usage and meaning of the tactic ID should be communicated between buyer and exchanges a priori.

fields.name: language
fields.type_spec: string standard code “xx” may also be used if the creative has no linguistic content (e.g., a banner with just a company logo).

fields.name: dealid
fields.type_spec: string pertains to a private marketplace direct deal.

fields.name: exp
fields.type_spec: integer wait between the auction and the actual impression.
